assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production raster UI item-card wooden board background for a realistic antique shipyard game. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Make one independent rarity version of this exact board. Preserve the existing full rectangular 2:1 silhouette, perfectly straight horizontal/vertical edges, front-on orthographic camera, frame and four-corner-stud proportions, realistic fine horizontal woodgrain, and large clean empty dark center. Change ONLY the wood stain and metal material coloration for the rarity given below. Preserve enough contrast for ivory-white UI text placed later. Keep the border thin and subtle but clearly color-coded; the main wood face also carries this rarity color. Entire board opaque, only outside the board transparent. Board fills the image as tightly as the reference, no large padding. No objects, text, letters, numerals, symbols, icons, labels, illustrated components, scenery, glow, particles, neon, gradients, color swatches or comparison grid. Output a single board, landscape 2:1.
Rarity version: 普通 (common). Color/material direction: desaturated cool gray-brown aged wood, clearly neutral graphite-gray/silver thin metal border and four silver-gray corner studs; no golden or colorful tint.
